title: Real’s Monthly Agent Survey: Competitive Economics Remain the Top Driver of Brokerage Choice
summary: Commissions remain the top factor in agents' brokerage choice, with revenue share, equity opportunities, and culture also playing meaningful roles The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX, “Real”), a leading real estate technology platform redefining the industry through innovation and culture, today released results from its June 2026 Agent Survey. The findings reinforce a consistent trend seen across prior Real surveys: while commission splits and overall economics remain the single most important factor in agents' choice of brokerage, revenue share and equity opportunities, company culture, and brokerage support also play meaningful roles in how agents evaluate where to build their businesses.
